Contract ManageCashDeskCRUDService::deleteCashDesk(id: Integer): Boolean {
	precondition:
		self.CurrentStore.AssociationCashdeskes->exists(cd: CashDesk|cd.Id = id)
	postcondition:
		let cashDesk: CashDesk = self.CurrentStore.AssociationCashdeskes@pre->any(cd: CashDesk|cd.Id = id) in
		self.CurrentStore.AssociationCashdeskes->excludes(cashDesk) and
		result = true
}
